item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second vertical 9:16 playful photo-montage reel using ALL FIVE references as five distinct shots, in this order. Preserve the actual people, animals, clothing and settings in the supplied photographs; animate mostly with editorial camera motion rather than changing faces. Vibe: weekend chaos to bliss, colorful, joyful, humorous. 0.0–1.5s: @dog, bouncy gentle push-in on the happy golden retriever. 1.5–2.8s: hard smash cut to @cat, quick comedic punch-in on the surprised expression. 2.8–4.5s: @friends, sunny beach selfie, slight swaying photo motion; keep BOTH friends visible by fitting the original photo within the vertical frame over a softly blurred matching background. 4.5–6.1s: @portrait, upbeat gentle zoom-out on the woman in the park, preserve likeness. 6.1–8.0s: @lake, serene wide scenic finale with a slow drift and subtle water ripples. Use crisp beat-matched cuts, a tiny playful whip transition between friends and portrait, no morphing between subjects. Fit photos without cutting off faces; use blurred matching fill when necessary. Add upbeat funky instrumental music with bouncy bass, handclaps and a funny small percussion accent on the cat cut, then a gentle resolving flourish at the lake. No speech, no invented people, no text or logos.
